# Dorfromantik

## Where is the options page?

The [player options page](../player-options) has all the options you need to configure and export a config file.

## What does randomization do to this game?

Normally, Dorfromantik gives you a stack of 40 tiles and lets you earn more by placing
tiles perfectly and by completing quests. In Archipelago, both of those are turned off.

Your tile stack is your Archipelago inventory. A run lasts exactly as many placements as
you have been given tiles, and when the stack runs out the run ends and you start another.
Progress is kept between runs, so a bad run costs you nothing but time.

You also start with only one type of terrain. Until you receive more, the game will only
generate tiles containing terrain you own, and — because Dorfromantik picks quest tiles to
match the landscape — flags for terrain you do not own will not appear at all.

## What items and locations get shuffled?

Items:

- **Terrain tiles** (Forest, Field, Village, Water, Train Track). Each grants both more
  tiles and a heavier presence of that terrain in the mix.
- **Quest Tiles**, each adding one guaranteed flag tile to every run.
- **Tile Packs**, generic tiles with no terrain preference.
- The game's **tile and biome unlocks**, such as the windmill, the boat, and the Sakura
  biome. Cosmetic skins are not shuffled.

Locations:

- Completing flags, counted across all your runs.
- Completing flags of a specific terrain.
- Reaching score milestones within a single run.

## What is the goal?

Whichever you choose: reach a target score in one run, or complete a target number of
flags in one run. Both ask your last run to be your best one.

How much you are given to get there depends on the Skill setting — a higher one means a
shorter deck for the same goal, so every tile has to pull more weight.

## Which items can be in another player's world?

Any of them.

tutorials.text:
# Dorfromantik Setup Guide

## Required Software

- Dorfromantik on Steam
- [BepInEx 5.4.23.x (x64)](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)
- The Dorfromantik Archipelago mod
- An `unstripped_corlib` folder (bundled with the mod)

## Installing BepInEx

Dorfromantik ships a **stripped** `mscorlib.dll`, and BepInEx will crash the game at
startup without a full one — with no log file, which makes it look like BepInEx simply
never installed. The mod download includes an `unstripped_corlib` folder to fix this.

1. Extract BepInEx into the Dorfromantik install folder, next to `Dorfromantik.exe`.
2. Copy the `unstripped_corlib` folder into that same folder.
3. Open `doorstop_config.ini` and, under `[UnityMono]`, set:

   ```
   dll_search_path_override = unstripped_corlib
   ```

4. Run the game once. `BepInEx/config` should appear. If it does not, BepInEx did not
   load — check step 3.

## Installing the mod

Place the mod DLL in `BepInEx/plugins/DorfromantikAP/`, then launch the game once to
generate `BepInEx/config/io.github.dorfromantik.archipelago.cfg`.

## Connecting

Set `ApModeEnabled = true` in that config file, along with your slot name and the server
address.

Archipelago runs use their own save folder (`Archipelago/<slot>/` inside the game's save
directory), so your vanilla saves, rewards and challenge progress are never touched.

## Playing

Start runs from **Your Games → New Game**, in Classic mode. Your stack will contain exactly
the tiles Archipelago has given you. When it runs out, the run ends — start another. Flags
you complete are sent as checks, and your totals carry across runs.

The **Resume** button is disabled in AP mode. The main menu runs a live game behind itself
as its backdrop, and that one is dealt before Archipelago answers, so resuming it would
give you a stand-in deck instead of your real inventory.

# Dorfromantik Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) randomizer for
[Dorfromantik](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455840/Dorfromantik/), the quiet
tile-laying game.

Your stack of tiles becomes your Archipelago inventory. A run lasts exactly as many
placements as you have been given, and the terrain you may build with is unlocked piece
by piece. A run that ends short is not a dead seed, just the next attempt.

## What you need

- Dorfromantik on Steam (Windows)
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.8 or newer
- Two files from the [releases page](https://github.com/Str8UpWHITE64/Dorfromantik-AP/releases):
  `Dorfromantik-AP-v<version>.zip` (the mod, with BepInEx 5 and the fix it needs already
  inside) and `dorfromantik.apworld`

## Install

1. In Steam, right-click Dorfromantik, then Manage, then Browse local files.
2. Extract the whole `Dorfromantik-AP` zip into that folder, next to `Dorfromantik.exe`.
   Overwrite if asked.
3. Double-click `dorfromantik.apworld` to install it into Archipelago, or copy it to the
   `custom_worlds` folder of your Archipelago install.
4. Start the game once. A connection window opens over the main menu. If the game closes
   at startup and there is no `BepInEx\LogOutput.log`, see
   [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

## Play

1. Make your YAML: in the Archipelago launcher, Generate Template Options, then edit
   `Dorfromantik.yaml`. Set your slot name (for example `Player1`) and your goal. Every
   option is explained in [docs/OPTIONS.md](docs/OPTIONS.md).
2. Generate and host the multiworld, or join one that someone else hosts.
3. Start Dorfromantik. In the connection window enter the server (for example
   `localhost` and the port), your slot name exactly as in your YAML, and the password if
   the room has one. Press **Connect**. The game never connects by itself.
4. Start runs from **Your Games, New Game**, in Classic mode. Resume is disabled while the
   randomizer is on.

Good to know:

- What you entered is saved to `BepInEx\config\DorfromantikAP.cfg`, so next time you only
  press **Connect**.
- **Play Vanilla** in the window turns the randomizer off for that session. The
  **Archipelago** button at the top middle of the main menu opens and closes the window.
- Randomizer runs use their own save folder and do not post to the leaderboard, set your
  high score or unlock Steam achievements. Your vanilla saves are never touched.

More in [the setup guide](apworld/dorfromantik/docs/setup_en.md). What the randomizer
shuffles is on [the game page](apworld/dorfromantik/docs/en_Dorfromantik.md).

## Logs

Each time the game starts, the mod writes a log of that session to
`BepInEx\DorfromantikAP\logs\AP_<date>_<time>.log` in the game folder. It lists the connection,
the items you receive and the checks you send, by name, with a status line every five
minutes. The newest 10 are kept. Send the newest one with your bug report, along with your
YAML and what you were doing.

If the game crashed, also send `BepInEx\LogOutput.log`. BepInEx overwrites it on the next
launch, so copy it right after the problem.

## Known issues

- Resume is disabled in randomizer mode, because the main menu deals its backdrop game
  before Archipelago answers. Use New Game.

Others are on the [issues page](https://github.com/Str8UpWHITE64/Dorfromantik-AP/issues).

## More

- [Options](docs/OPTIONS.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Building and contributing](docs/DEVELOPING.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

# Dorfromantik Archipelago v0.1.0

## What it does

Dorfromantik normally hands you 40 tiles and lets you earn more by placing perfectly and
completing quests. Both are switched off here. A run lasts exactly as many placements as
Archipelago has given you — when the stack empties, the run ends and you start another.
Progress carries across runs, so a bad run costs nothing but time.

You start with one terrain type. Until you receive more, the game only generates tiles for
terrain you own, and flags for terrain you don't own never appear at all.

- **Items** — Terrain tiles (Forest, Field, Village, Water, Train Track), Quest Tiles,
  generic Tile Packs, and the game's 22 tile and biome unlocks.
- **Locations** — Flags completed, counted overall, per terrain, and within a single run,
  plus score milestones.
- **Goal** — Your choice, and both are single-run achievements: reach a target score in one
  run, or complete a target number of flags in one run.

## Options

There are four, and that is deliberate. **Goal**, your target, **Skill**, and **Tiles Per
Pack**.

Skill decides how much you are given to reach your goal, and means the same thing on both
goals: how much of what you are handed you actually convert. Every figure is measured from
real play.

| Skill | Points per tile | Tiles to reach 5000 | Flags closed |
|---|---|---|---|
| easy | 25.0 | 200 | 70% |
| medium | 27.8 | 180 | 78% |
| hard | 30.3 | 165 | 87% |
| pro | 33.3 | 150 | 95% |

Everything else — deck length, flag tiles, how many checks exist — is derived from your
goal. There is no option for pool size or check count on purpose: either would compete with
the goal, and the larger number would quietly win, leaving seeds finishable long before
their items arrived.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Dorfromantik-AP-v0.1.0.zip` | The game mod. BepInEx included — drop-in. |
| `dorfromantik.apworld` | The Archipelago world. Needs Archipelago 0.6.8+. |

## Install

**Mod** — Extract the zip into your Dorfromantik folder, next to `Dorfromantik.exe`.
That's the whole install; BepInEx ships with it, already configured.
(Steam: right-click Dorfromantik → Manage → Browse local files.)

Launch the game once and quit, which creates
`BepInEx\config\io.github.dorfromantik.archipelago.cfg`. Open it and set:

```ini
ApModeEnabled = true
Slot = your slot name
Host = your server
Port = your port
